source: Meta Marketing API (no native BQ export - schema designed by us)

tables.name: meta_Account
tables.grain: one row per ad account per _DATA_DATE (daily snapshot); PK (account_id, _DATA_DATE); filter _DATA_DATE = _LATEST_DATE for current state

tables.name: meta_Campaign
tables.grain: one row per campaign per _DATA_DATE (daily snapshot); PK (campaign_id, _DATA_DATE); filter _DATA_DATE = _LATEST_DATE for current state

tables.name: meta_AdSet
tables.grain: one row per ad set per _DATA_DATE (daily snapshot); PK (adset_id, _DATA_DATE); carries campaign_id + account_id for joins

tables.name: meta_Ad
tables.grain: one row per ad per _DATA_DATE (daily snapshot); PK (ad_id, _DATA_DATE); carries adset_id + campaign_id + account_id for joins

tables.name: meta_CampaignStats
tables.grain: account_id x campaign_id x segments_date x segments_impression_device x segments_device_platform x segments_publisher_platform x segments_platform_position

tables.name: meta_AdSetStats
tables.grain: account_id x campaign_id x adset_id x segments_date x segments_impression_device x segments_device_platform x segments_publisher_platform x segments_platform_position

tables.name: meta_AdStats
tables.grain: account_id x campaign_id x adset_id x ad_id x segments_date x segments_impression_device x segments_device_platform x segments_publisher_platform x segments_platform_position

tables.name: meta_CampaignActions
tables.grain: account_id x campaign_id x segments_date x action_collection x action_type x action-breakdown context keys (action_device, action_destination, action_target_id, action_reaction, action_video_sound, action_video_type, action_canvas_component_name, action_carousel_card_id, action_carousel_card_name, action_converted_product_id, conversion_destination, standard_event_content_type)

tables.name: meta_CampaignDemographics
tables.grain: account_id x campaign_id x segments_date x segments_age x segments_gender

tables.name: meta_CampaignPlacements
tables.grain: account_id x campaign_id x segments_date x segments_publisher_platform x segments_platform_position x segments_device_platform x segments_impression_device
